title: Pawko
tagline: Drop waves of balls down a pinboard of pegs and play a card between waves

fr.tagline: Entre le hasard cruel d'un pachinko et la stratégie magique, tes pattounes de chat porte-bonheur ne suffiront pas. Maîtrise tes cartes, lance les sorts au millimètre et déclenche un combo dévastateur pour pulvériser tous les records !

en.tagline: Between the cruel luck of a pachinko and magical strategy, your lucky cat paws won't be enough. Master your cards, cast spells with pinpoint precision and trigger a devastating combo to smash every record!

description: Pawko is a pachinko board with a hand of cards over it, built for combinations. A game is five waves of balls, and before each one you drag one card of your hand onto the board: where you let it go is where the wave falls from, and the slot is dealt a new card for the next wave. Every point a peg or an exit pays is multiplied by the global multiplier in force, and fifty cards of four kinds feed it. Peg cards turn the board into fire, ice, bumpers, magnets, bombs, prisms, sparks, glass, portals or spikes for the rest of the game. Wave cards fatten, freeze, burn, charge or double one wave. Charms stay for the game and grow, from a pyromaniac to a domino of bombs. Two tricks copy or bring back the last card played. Find the right synergy and the multiplier runs away with the score. Thirty levels, four new cards a level up to the twelfth, each asking for a higher score off a board that always opens plain brass.
